steps.en: Prepare isolated CUDA Python, reviewed weights and adapter
steps.zh: 准备隔离 CUDA 环境及已核权重和适配器

steps.en: Set a licensed image, trusted prompts and bounded clip count
steps.zh: 指定有权使用的图、可信提示和片段上限

steps.en: Run the matching main-branch SVI2.0 example
steps.zh: 调用主分支对应的 SVI2.0 示例

steps.en: Load Wan2.1 I2V14B and the SVI adapter on the GPU
steps.zh: 在显卡载入 Wan2.1 I2V14B 和 SVI 适配器

steps.en: Generate clips using each prompt and previous motion frames
steps.zh: 按逐段提示和前段运动帧接续生成

steps.en: Join non-overlapping frames and save the cumulative MP4
steps.zh: 去掉重叠帧并保存累积 MP4

value.en: A prompt-driven continuation video without manually wiring every cross-clip handoff
value.zh: 获得逐段提示驱动的接续视频，不必手工连接每段条件
